The '''Lutrillian Cross''' was a hyperspace route created about [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]] by [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] provided a direct connection between [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]] located on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]]. This was accomplished by blazing a short cut through the [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax Nebula]], one half of the larger [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]].
